scope: Fail-closed successor checklist for a future fresh shared Release build and, only after a separately frozen readiness and single-use authorization, one-shot GPU evidence for the V19 dedicated trajectory inset. This checklist executes no configure, build, test, GPU, readiness, capture or authorization action and does not convert rules audit completeness or CP4 CPU/static acceptance into product acceptance.

requirements: Each of the four zero-reference V19 implementation sources has exactly one owning library or executable source list; duplicate compilation into multiple final-link paths is forbidden.
The owner exposes all required CP1, CP3 and CP4 symbols to ModernRenderer without relying on unresolved static archive members.
A dedicated CPU test target compiles and runs tests/phase4_v19_trajectory_inset_visible_integration_cpu_tests.cpp with the actual Core41 link shim.

A final-link closure target directly instantiates and calls the ModernRenderer CP4 visible path so modern_renderer.o and all four V19 implementation objects are pulled; an archive-only build or unrelated smoke target is insufficient.
The stale ModernGpuResources production-link comment is corrected or removed without changing runtime behavior.
The exact target names, source ownership, dependency graph, binary paths and expected symbols are frozen before any CMake edit or build.

future_fresh_release_cpu_build_closure_n.required_rules_validation: Audit v10's own frozen validator/generator lineage must be replayed according to its receipt; summary values may not be inferred from a successful build.
future_fresh_release_cpu_build_closure_n.required_result: All named targets build from one fresh Release directory; all named CPU tests and validators pass; exact binary, object, command, stdout/stderr and source/CMake hashes are frozen in one CPU closure receipt.

required_before_readiness: A separately reviewed capture-producer contract identifies an exact current V19 inset-capable binary target and single dispatcher path.
The binary is built from the same fresh Release closure and its SHA is frozen.

The capture plan accepts only explicit TrainingSession or ReplayPlayback current requests, inset ON, world overlay OFF, current CP1/CP2/CP3/CP4 identities, and exact 1x/2x/4x sample profile requested by each case.
The plan binds output paths, physical dimensions, palette, screen, layout profile, session/frame/layout/package generations, semantic inventory and expected no-fallback behavior before authorization.
Valid-fail-valid GL/context-loss preflight, CJK atlas, target attachment, Core41 restore ownership, final semantic R32UI and product-present barriers pass in the fresh binary.
No readiness or authorization exists from an old world-overlay, CP1, CP2, CP3 or CPU-only receipt.
capture_producer_and_readiness_precondit.historical_evidence_not_inheritable: All old Phase4 world-overlay v1-v3 and V4 readiness, targeted, final-ownership and GPU capture receipts plus the Phase4 OverlayV4 runner are historical only. None proves a V19 inset producer, V19 current-request path, V19 independent semantic plane or V19 final product composition.
